data.body: Implementation progress: added direct monotonic wrapper, attempt, handle-resolution, snapshot-context, inner-setup, dispatch, annotation, and finalization timings plus existing-work attempt/resume/workflow-step counts. The probe now loads the hierarchy, derives unattributed_verifier_ms only from verifier_call_ms minus the six non-overlapping wrapper partitions with a 6 ms tolerance, and preserves legacy rows. Evidence: focused instrumentation+probe tests 26 passed; related close/snapshot/consumption tests passed; import walk 468 package modules + 61 scripts passed; make lint passed; make typecheck passed; complexity new=0 increased=0; fully instrumented synthetic wrapper upper bound 6.542 us over 100000 iterations. Per operator direction about limited local resources, the serial default suite was intentionally stopped cleanly at 6% (exit 130, no failures observed); full-suite verification is delegated to Gerrit CI.
